test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to replace the underlined word in the given sentence.

Rama has been very __unlucky __in the last few years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**hapless**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **unlucky **can be replaced by the word **hapless **as they both are *synonymous *to each other.
 
• SYNONYM is *a phrase or word with the same or well almost the same meaning as another phrase or word. *
 
• The word **Unlucky **means bad luck.
 
• The word **Hapless **means unfortunate
 
• The meaning of both the word is **similar **, *hence they both can be replaced by each other.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Unnerving **means leading a person to loose confidence.
 
• *Example *: I had an **unnerving **experience in childhood,
 
• The word **Undeserving **means not worthy of something.
 
• *Example *: The applicant is **undeserving **of assistance.
 
• The word **Degraded **means reducing the quality
 
• *Example *: These are **degraded **products.
